patients.label: 52-year-old man with relapsed FLT3-ITD AML on Gilteritinib and bilateral neurotrophic keratitis

identity_evidence.quote: A 52-year-old male patient presented to our department

attribution_limitations: The source attributes the keratitis to Gilteritinib only with hedged wording ("potentially associated", "most likely related"). No causal fact is asserted; the statement that all known etiologies were excluded names no specific tests.

The abstract says the keratitis developed after two years of Gilteritinib, while the case text says the drug was received for two years with no start or stop dates; whether treatment was still ongoing at presentation is not stated and is not inferred.

The caption assigns baseline to panels A and B, 1 week to C and D, and 1 month to E and F, and says both eyes were imaged, but prints no laterality per panel. Which eye each panel shows is not inferred.

The discussion says autologous serum was contraindicated by the hematologic condition and cenegermin was not commercially available. These are not recorded as patient treatments given, declined or planned.
